To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the toxigenicity of the clinical group A Streptroococcus strains is determined by the expression of the toxigenicity (speA) gene, which is localized in the moderate bacteriophage.
the production of type A streptococcus erythrogenic (erythrogenic) toxin is determined by the presence of the toxigenicity (toxigenicity) gene in moderate phage genome.
the toxigenicity of group A streptococcal strains is determined by the gene of type-A erythrogenic toxins.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and localization of toxigenicity gene of group A Strepto­cocci in strains of group C and group G.
the identification of the gene responsible for the production of erythrogenic toxins and the development of a DNA probe for the detection of the toxigenicity in strains of group-A Streptococcus.
the identification of toxigenicity genes in strains of group a Streptococcus and with the development of a new method for the identification of toxigencity in streptococcal strains.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
toxigenicity is a property of a strain and not of a clone.
toxigenicity is a property of the group A Streptroccocus which is controlled by the toxigenicity factor.
the gene of type А erythrogenic toxigenic factor is located in the genome of moderate bacteriophage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the type A toxin is encoded by the gene located in the bacteriophage genome and that the degree of toxignicity is related to the gene dose.
the toxigenicity of group A Strepto- cocci strains is associated with the expression of the toxigenicity genes localized in the moderate bacteriophage genomes.
the toxigenicity of clinical streptococcus is related to the tox gene expression and the gene dose is an essential factor of toxigenicity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the toxigenicity is related to a specific gene and that it can be detected using DNA probes.
the presence of the toxigenicity determinant gene in clinical strepto­cocci strains is a necessary condition for their toxigenicity, and its absence is a sufficient one.
toxigenicity is a heritable trait that can be assessed by DNA probes and is related to the gene dose.
